Definition: abbreviated, i.e. diminutive, literally (in quantity, size or number) or figuratively (in age or importance)
BiblicalUsage: Small is the word for the child king, the little coat, and the little cake: Solomon says, I am but a little child, I know not how to go out or come in; Samuel's mother made him a little coat, and brought it to him from year to year; and Elijah says to the widow, make me thereof a little cake first.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe smallness is where God starts, because the child king, the child prophet, and the widow's last cake are all the beginning of something great, and each small thing offered first is what makes it enough.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
